context: Sazza is a goblin prisoner locked in a cage after being spared (or halted) from execution; off‑screen there has been violence and interrogation by tieflings and/or drow commanders pressing prisoners about the druid grove. She loudly proclaims loyalty to the Absolute and to a “boss lady” — a drow/goblin leader — and assumes the player might be connected to that authority. In a coercive, desperate tone she bargains for freedom, offering to introduce or lead the player to her tribe at the goblin camp if you free her. Game flags set by this scene determine whether she lives and whether she later turns up again in the goblin camp; nearby party members may react differently depending on prior choices.
